metadata.question: Did the temperature over Córdoba airport reach over 40 degrees Celcius on April 26, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Córdoba airport (Spain or Argentina - most likely Argentina given context) - Date: April 26, 2023 (single day) - Collection: MODIS LST (MOD11A1/MYD11A1) or ERA5-Land temperature data - ERA5-Land provides 2m air temperature which is more relevant for "temperature" questions 2. Masking strategy: - For temperature data, no cloud masking needed - ERA5-Land provides hourly data, MODIS provides day/night LST - Need to check maximum temperature during the day 3. Logic: - Valid result: Any temperature value in reasonable range (-50 to 60°C) - If max temp > 40°C → Answer A (Yes) - If max temp ≤ 40°C → Answer B (No) - If no data → C1 - If calculation fails → C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Córdoba Airport, Argentina (most likely - main international airport) const cordobaAirport = ee.Geometry.Point([-64.2083, -31.3236]); // Date range for April 26, 2023 const startDate = '2023-04-26'; const endDate = '2023-04-27'; // Get ERA5-Land hourly temperature data (2m air temperature) let tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cordobaAirport) .select('temperature_2m'); const collectionSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5-Land images found: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No ERA5-Land data available. Trying MODIS LST...'); // Fallback to MODIS Terra LST tempCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cordobaAirport) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const modisSize = tempCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${modisSize}`); if (modisSize === 0) { console.log('No temperature data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get maximum temperature across all hours/images const maxTemp = tempCollection.max(); // Calculate max temperature at airport location const result = maxTemp.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: cordobaAirport, scale: 11000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const tempValue = result.values().get(0).getInfo(); if (tempValue === null || tempValue === undefined) { console.log('Temperature calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius (ERA5-Land is in Kelvin) // MODIS LST is in Kelvin * 0.02, need to convert let tempCelsius; if (tempValue > 200) { // ERA5-Land format (Kelvin) tempCelsius = tempValue - 273.15; } else { // MODIS format (Kelvin * 0.02) tempCelsius = (tempValue * 0.02) - 273.15; } console.log(`Maximum temperature on April 26, 2023: ${tempCelsius.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Validate reasonable temperature range if (tempCelsius < -50 || tempCelsius > 60) { console.log('Temperature value outside reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if temperature exceeded 40°C if (tempCelsius > 40) { console.log('Temperature exceeded 40°C.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Temperature did not exceed 40°C.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
